row_scope: 23 visually reviewed Northwest nonstop schedules on 10 directed pairs: Madison to/from ORD, MKE and MSP; Grand Rapids, Michigan to/from DTW and MSP.
airport_mapping: O=Chicago O’Hare/ORD. Grand Rapids, Michigan=GRR; the separate Minnesota city is excluded. MSN and GRR have CST and EST respectively in this period.
time_notation: All selected arrivals are on the same local calendar day. GRR–MSP takes 77 minutes despite 17-minute local-clock difference.
excluded_candidates: MSP–MKE224 and DTW–MSP375 are aggregate multi-stop rows. Only separately timed legs are added.
MSP–GRR524/763 is a connection via DTW, not a nonstop.
Grand Rapids, Minnesota Airlink1052/1056 not attributed to GRR or Northwest mainline.
caveat: OCR for discovery only; original images verify each accepted field. No evidence of actual operation or aircraft identity.
